_note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every scheduled task across all hosts (Cowork, laptop daemon, Task Scheduler). Built 2026-06-27. Replaces ad-hoc 'check Claude scheduled' as tasks migrate off Cowork. Command Center should render sortable views over THIS file (by agent / model / host / tier / weekly tokens). 'currentTier' = where it runs today; 'recommendedTier' = target after migration. Routing policy lives in this file.
_sync_protocol: Accuracy is maintained by SYNC-PROTOCOL.md in this folder. Rule: any session that creates/edits/deletes a scheduled task on ANY host MUST update this file in the same change. A nightly registry-reconcile infra task diffs declared vs. actual (Cowork list_scheduled_tasks, Windows schtasks, laptop daemon) and flags drift. See SYNC-PROTOCOL.md.
_agent_specs: Agentic-loop specs live in Claude/Assistant/agents/ (AGENT-LOOP.md scaffold + finance-agent.md + health-agent.md + state/*.json).

routing_legend.max: Runs on Claude/Max plan (Cowork). Reserve for Tier-2 JUDGMENT: theses, synthesis, plan composition, voice, client-facing.
routing_legend.open: Runs on OpenRouter via gateway+openmodel_worker (DeepSeek V3.2 workhorse / Qwen3-Coder for code). Mechanical/high-volume: scrape, score, dedupe, data pulls, freshness gates, assembly, file-existence QC.
routing_legend.open-first: Bulk runs open; only the thin judgment slice escalates to Max via the Agent Dispatch queue.
routing_legend.private: Touches personal health data — MUST NOT go to cloud-open per the health-data rule. Stays Max now; LOCAL model later (never free-cloud).

rate_assumptions.note: Max marginal cost is $0 under cap, but Eddie hits ~95% of weekly cap — so the real currency is CAP HEADROOM, not dollars. Every 'open' move reclaims Max capacity for 'max'-tier work.
